item.title: Multi-Threading with Web Workers
item.description: We’ve repeated it several times throughout these notes: JavaScript is single-threaded. Normally, that’s fine. But what happens if you need to process a 50MB CSV file, apply image blur filters, or run heavy cryptographic hashing in the browser? If you run that loop on the main thread, the entire browser tab completely freezes. Buttons stop clicking, typing halts, and the dreaded “Page Unresponsive” popup appears. :') The solution? Offload heavy calculations onto genuine background threads using Web Workers.
